result.brief: 提出无提升（lifting-free）的外中心到自我中心视频生成方法，用LVSM式学习视图合成器替代深度点云重投影作为扩散模型条件，并利用对应分布置信度引导去噪。
result.reason: Proposes a learned view synthesizer (LVSM-style transformer) as conditioning for video diffusion, contributing a novel-view video generation method with representation/conditioning design.
